summary: Backend SaaS multi-tenant testing complete. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_saas_multitenant.py (21 tests) covering signup/login/me, tenant provisioning with trialing, /me/tenant, /api/plans (starter monthly R$49 & yearly R$490 with 14-day trial + limits), Stripe subscription checkout, CROSS-TENANT ISOLATION (competition_types & competitions listing scoped; PUT/DELETE/draw/bracket on other-tenant competition returns 404; admin/users & admin/finance scoped), super_admin platform/stats & platform/tenants (403 for non-super-admin), plan limit enforcement (6th competition -> 402), and public marketplace unauth still returns all competitions + rankings. 21/21 pass.

minor.issue: Public single-competition GET does not verify tenant; any tenant_id/competition_id is retrievable if guessed. Intentional for public marketplace but worth flagging.
Public reads of teams/matches/list_matches are not tenant-scoped (readable to anyone with competition_id). OK for public marketplace but read-only, and consistent with public competition detail.
delete_type uses tenant_scope but there is no update endpoint; delete is silent if not owner (returns ok:true even when 0 deleted). Consider 404 for cross-tenant delete.

action_items: Consider returning 404 (or 403) on cross-tenant DELETE /api/competition-types/{type_id} instead of silent ok:true.
Consider optional tenant filtering (or 404) on GET /api/competitions/{id}, /matches, /teams if marketplace visibility should be limited to competitions of active tenants only.
CORS still uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True (from prev iteration) — browsers may reject; explicit origin list recommended.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1846 lines — split by concern (auth, tenants/plans/subscriptions, competitions, registrations, matches, admin, platform, email).

resolve_principal auto-creates a tenant on any authenticated call if user has none. Good for legacy Google-OAuth users, but silently succeeds even after admin deletes a tenant. Consider explicit re-provision endpoint.

_admin_owns_or_raise uses 404 (good, hides existence); however DELETE /competition-types/{type_id} bypasses it via tenant_scope() and returns ok even if nothing deleted. Should return 404 on cross-tenant.
list_types & list_competitions parse Authorization header manually — duplicated code that could be a dependency (optional_user).
PLAN_LIMITS['starter']['athletes']=200 exists but is not enforced anywhere in registrations code path — only 'tournaments' limit is enforced. Athlete cap will be exceeded silently.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 new SaaS tests + previously 20/20 core tests)

test_credentials: Owner: danieloliveira78@gmail.com / ArenaHub@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Session token returned in JSON body of /api/auth/signup and /api/auth/login for Bearer-header testing.
seed_data_creation: Fixture creates two ephemeral tenants (A/B) via /api/auth/signup with random emails TEST_A_*/TEST_B_*. Additional per-test tenants for limit + duplicate-email + non-super-admin checks. Post-run cleanup script removed all test_ tenants + their competition_types/competitions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_saas_multitenant.py -v (parallel-safe, uses LoadScopeScheduling). Backend base URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Signup returns lowercase email (server normalizes) so assertions use .lower(). All tenant isolation checks confirmed working: A's competition/type is invisible to B, and cross-tenant mutations (PUT/DELETE/draw/bracket) all correctly 404. Plan limit (5 tournaments) enforced with 402 on 6th create. Super admin (danieloliveira78) has full platform access; regular users get 403 on /api/platform/*.
rca of the issue: No new issues found. Two initial test failures were self-inflicted (server lowercases email but test compared with mixed-case TEST_ prefix); fixed by comparing .lower().
